kpis.description_fr: Volume pub transité plateforme TTD (avant take-rate ~20%). Métrique scale dominant DSP indépendant. Croissance soutenue CTV.
kpis.description_en: Total ad spend transacted on TTD platform (before ~20% take rate). Dominant independent DSP scale metric. Sustained CTV growth.

kpis.description_en: CTV (Connected TV) revenue mix. Strongest growth vertical, drives linear TV to streaming shift. DSP CTV leader.

kpis.description_en: Adj EBITDA margin. Very high (platform model), stable despite Kokai + UID2 investments. Structural 40%+ target.

kpis.description_fr: Taux rétention clients agences/brands (>12 mois). Exceptionnel 9 années consécutives. Switching costs élevés.
kpis.description_en: Customer retention (agencies/brands, >12 mo). Exceptional 9 consecutive years. High switching costs.

kpis.description_fr: Mix CA hors US. Croissance progressive Europe + APAC, runway long (US = 88% encore). Cible 30%+ MT.
kpis.description_en: Non-US revenue mix. Gradual EU + APAC growth, long runway (US still 88%). 30%+ MT target.
